items.title: Willie J. Humphrey Interview, 1979-11-29
items.q: Helen Ault and all of them... our group, used to do a lot of gratties for them. We'd play their concerts and things you know.

ctx.x: Have you found like in the past fifteen years that jazz is being appreciated, like a lot more people are listening to?

Well yeah. What would happen, I think the jazz club had a whole lot to do with keeping it alive. Because I used to do a whole lot of it. I don't know if you know, Harry Schuchon and Doc Schuchon. They're French. Well there was Helen Ault and all of them. I don't know if you know her. You don't know anything about jazz at all then. You don't know them because they don't want to keep the jazz club. Still it's not as live as it should be now. But they kept it and we used to, our group, used to do a lot of gratties…
Where do you like to play the most? Which city? New Orleans? Well I don't know.
